caption: The drawing depicts a fragmented statue rendered in shades of brown and beige, showing the upper body and partial lower section of a draped figure. The figure is positioned in a seated posture, with its head tilted back and mouth slightly open, looking upwards. The upper torso displays pronounced anatomical features, and the garment wrapped around the body is realistically folded and layered. The statue appears broken at the bottom and along the left hand side, with jagged edges evident. The background of the drawing is a pale, off-white color, and the statue is centered with a soft rectangular shadow or highlight behind it, emphasizing the central subject. There are no other objects in the drawing, and all attention is focused on the detailed rendering of the stone-like figure.
title: Figurehead
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
